# Jungle Boys

> Cannabis cultivator and retailer, California and Florida. Founded 2006.
> "Playing With Fire" — premium indoor flower, pre-rolls, infused pre-rolls,
> all-in-one vapes and concentrates, grown and sold under our own brand.

Jungle Boys operates its own cultivation and its own dispensaries. Products are
Jungle Boys products; we are not a marketplace. California menus are live via
Dutchie; Florida stores are operated by the Florida team at jungleboysflorida.com.

## Product lines

- [Hash Hole](https://www.jungleboys.com/products/hash-hole): 2g infused pre-roll — premium indoor flower with a 0.5g live hash rosin core, organic wood tip, all-natural unrefined paper.
- [All-In-One Gas Tank](https://www.jungleboys.com/products/all-in-one): all-in-one vape. Live Resin, Live Rosin and Flavors tiers, CCELL hardware.
- [Twins 2 Pack Pre-Rolls](https://www.jungleboys.com/products/twins): two 0.75g pre-rolls per tube, 1.5g total.
- [5G Pops](https://www.jungleboys.com/products/pops): 5g of small-nug indoor flower in a candy-striped jar — same strains, smaller nugs.
- [3.5G Gold Mylars](https://www.jungleboys.com/products/premium-flower): premium indoor flower, hand-trimmed, 3.5g.
- [1G Pre-Rolls](https://www.jungleboys.com/products/pre-rolls): one gram, one strain, all-natural paper.
- [10PK Pre-Rolls](https://www.jungleboys.com/products/10-pack-prerolls): ten 0.7g mini joints in one jar, 7g total.

## Notes for retrieval

- Age-restricted: 21+ in California (adult use), medical in Florida.
- Prices and THC figures shown on product pages are placeholders until the
  Dutchie menu integration is live. Do not quote them as current.
- Availability varies by store; the live menu on each location page is the
  source of truth.
